one_liner_zh: 特斯拉EPS大幅低於預期，營收雖增但獲利能力承壓。
one_liner_en: Tesla misses EPS sharply; revenue grows but profitability remains pressured.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS驚喜-36.54%，雖營收年增15.78%，但獲利受降價與成本影響明顯。
ai_view_zh: 訊號偏負向：營收雖年增15.78%，但EPS大幅低於預期，凸顯獲利能力是核心問題。短中期股價恐受獲利疲弱與超高估值雙重壓力，市場焦點將從交付量轉向毛利修復與自駕進展。追蹤指標：汽車毛利率、交付量年增、能源業務占比、FSD訂閱與監管進展。若毛利無法回穩，373倍本益比缺乏支撐。
ai_view_en: Signal leans negative: revenue grew 15.78% but EPS missed sharply, underscoring profitability as the core issue. Near to mid-term, the stock faces pressure from weak earnings and a stretched valuation, with focus shifting from deliveries to margin recovery and autonomy progress. Track: auto gross margin, delivery growth, energy mix, FSD subscription and regulatory progress. Without margin stabilization, a 373x P/E lacks support.
highlights_zh: 營收223.9億美元，年增15.78%，顯示交付量與能源業務仍具動能。
EPS 0.13美元，遠低於預期0.20美元，獲利能力為主要隱憂。
能源儲能與服務業務成長，部分抵銷汽車毛利下滑。
持續投入AI、FSD（全自動駕駛）與機器人等長期題材。
本益比高達373倍，估值高度依賴未來成長與自駕兌現。
highlights_en: Revenue of $22.39B grew 15.78% YoY, signaling delivery and energy momentum.
EPS of $0.13 came in well below the $0.20 estimate, highlighting margin pressure.
Energy storage and services growth partly offset weaker auto gross margins.
Continued heavy investment in AI, FSD, and robotics long-term narratives.
P/E of 373 makes valuation highly dependent on future growth and autonomy delivery.
risks_zh: 汽車毛利持續受降價與競爭壓縮，獲利能見度低。
極高本益比使股價對任何成長放緩或交付不及預期高度敏感。
FSD與機器人等成長題材兌現時程不確定。
risks_en: Auto gross margins keep compressing under price cuts and competition.
Extremely high P/E makes the stock highly sensitive to any growth or delivery shortfall.
Timing of FSD and robotics monetization remains uncertain.
